ttft_p99.description: Time-to-first-token 99th percentile must be under 5 seconds

e2e_p99.description: End-to-end request latency 99th percentile must be under 60 seconds

request_throughput.description: Request throughput must be at least 1 request per second

severity_classification.nominal: All SLOs pass for the interval
severity_classification.critical: Any failing SLO of type histogram_percentile has measured value >= 2x its threshold
severity_classification.degraded: At least one SLO fails but no histogram_percentile SLO reaches 2x its threshold

error_budget.burn_rate_definition: Per-SLO burn rate = (fraction of observed intervals where the SLO failed) / (1 - target_availability). Overall burn rate = max of all per-SLO burn rates.
